info.name: Slaras Nusa Foodlab API
info.description:
# Slaras Nusa Foodlab API

Laravel 11 REST API for the Slaras Nusa Foodlab ERP, served under `/api`.

## Base URL
`{{baseURL}}` defaults to `http://localhost:8000` (docker nginx port). Every request path already includes `/api`.

## Authentication
Sanctum personal access tokens (`Authorization: Bearer {{bearerToken}}`).

1. Run **Auth > Login** (`admin@foodlab.test` / `password` with the default seeder).
2. The test script saves `data.token` into the `bearerToken` collection variable.
3. All other requests inherit that token from the collection auth.

Only `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `GET /api/health` and `GET /api/metrics` are public.

Every request sends `Accept: application/json`, so failures come back as JSON (`401`, `404`, `422`) instead of an HTML page or a `302` redirect.

## List endpoint conventions
All index endpoints support the same query language:

- `filter[search]=term`, `filter[company_id]=1`, ... — flat aliases (`?search=`, `?company_id=`) still work
- `sort=name` / `sort=-created_at`
- `include=company,expenseCategory` (camelCase relation names)
- `page` + `per_page` — without them the full filtered list is returned

## Response envelope
- Single resource: `{ "data": { ... } }`
- List: `{ "data": [ ... ], "meta": { "count", "total", "page", "per_page", "last_page", ... } }`
- Delete: `{ "message": "..." }`
- Validation failure: `422` with `{ "message", "errors": { field: [...] } }`
- Missing/invalid token: `401` with `{ "message": "Unauthenticated." }`

## Modules
| Module | Overview | Resources |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CFO (Keuangan) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cfo` | companies, capital-companies, company-assets, expense-categories, expense-types, expense-items |
| CHO (SDM) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cho` | overview only |
| CPO (Persediaan) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cpo` | overview only |
| CDO (Pemasaran) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cdo` | overview only |
| CMO (Penjualan) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cmo` | overview only |

`GET /api/v1/modules` aggregates every module overview.

FoodLab quality control lives at `GET/POST /api/v1/samples` and `GET /api/v1/samples/{id}`.

## Notes
- Deletes are soft deletes: financial/operational rows are kept with `deleted_at`.
- Mutations invalidate the Redis list caches and return `201` on create, `200` on update/delete.
- Interactive OpenAPI docs are generated by Scramble at `/docs/api` (`/docs/api.json`).

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sanctum personal access token flow.

`POST /auth/login` is public and throttled to 5 attempts per minute. Every other request inherits the collection-level `Authorization: Bearer {{bearerToken}}` header; running **Login** stores the token in that collection variable automatically.

request.description:
Creates a Sanctum access token for the given credentials. Public endpoint (throttled: 5 requests/minute).

The test script copies `data.token` into the `bearerToken` collection variable.

item.name: CFO
item.description:
CFO (Keuangan) — company master data, shareholders, company assets, expense categories, expense types and expense items. List endpoints share the same query conventions:

- filters: `filter[<field>]=value` (flat aliases such as `?search=` also work)
- sorting: `sort=field` / `sort=-field`
- relations: `include=relation` (camelCase relation names)
- pagination: `page` + `per_page`; without them the full list is returned

All mutating endpoints run in DB transactions. Deletes are soft deletes.

item.name: Company Assets
item.description:
Capitalised company assets (`company_assets`, Input Aset).

`total_price` is **derived server-side** as `amount x price_per_unit` (rounded to 2 decimals) and is never read from the request — sending it has no effect. `amount` is an integer with a minimum of 1.

Default ordering is newest asset first (`-asset_date`, then `-id`); the parent `company` is eager-loaded by default.

query.description: Page number (1-based). Sending `page` or `per_page` enables pagination.
Rows per page (default 10). Only used together with pagination.
Exact `company_id` match.
Partial match on `name`. Legacy flat alias: `?search=`.
Allowed sorts: `id`, `asset_date`, `name`, `amount`, `price_per_unit`, `total_price`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Default order is `-asset_date,-id`.
Eager-load the parent company (loaded by default when no `include` is sent).

item.name: FoodLab Samples
item.description:
FoodLab quality-control samples (`lab_samples`). Create/get responses also include a computed top-level `quality_grade`:

- `PASS` — pH 4.0–7.2 and moisture <= 90%
- `REVIEW` — pH 3.2–8.0 (outside the optimal range)
- `REJECT` — outside pH 3.2–8.0

There is no update/delete endpoint yet.

query.description: Page number (1-based). Sending `page` or `per_page` enables pagination.
Rows per page (default 10). Only used together with pagination.
Exact status match: `pending`, `approved` or `rejected`.
Exact product category match.
Partial match on `batch_code` or `product_name`. Legacy flat alias: `?search=`.
Allowed sorts: `id`, `batch_code`, `product_name`, `category`, `status`, `created_at`. Prefix with `-` for descending.
